cli.help.heading:
Manage ThriftyRelay settings and runtime.

Usage:
  thriftyrelay <command> [options]
cli.help.commands:
Commands:
  setup             Save settings and credentials.
  start             Start ThriftyRelay.
  stop              Stop ThriftyRelay.
  restart           Restart ThriftyRelay.
  status            Show local runtime status.
  doctor            Check settings and connection status.
  settings          View or change settings.
  uninstall         Stop, then remove settings, launcher, logs, and saved key.
  mcp               Check the Windows MCP task with mcp check, or restart it with mcp restart.
  recover           Recover an execution with an unknown outcome.
  register-policy   Register, show, or revoke the admission policy.
  lang              Show the display language, or save it with lang ja or lang en.
  help              Show this help.
cli.help.options:
Options:
  --lang ja|en        Set the display language.
  --json              Display JSON. Available for status, doctor, and settings show.
  --foreground        Run in this terminal. Available for start and restart on Linux and macOS.
  --yes               Skip uninstall confirmation.
  --dry-run           Show the uninstall plan.
  -h, --help          Show help.
cli.help.phase2:
Examples:
  thriftyrelay setup
  thriftyrelay status
  thriftyrelay doctor --json
  thriftyrelay settings show
  thriftyrelay --help

recovery.failure.interactive: Run `thriftyrelay recover` in a local interactive PowerShell console. No recovery was attempted.
recovery.failure.directory: The task directory could not be opened. No recovery was attempted.
recovery.failure.cancelled: Recovery was cancelled before approval. No unlock was requested.
recovery.failure.ownerActive: The recorded task is unfinished. Let it finish or inspect its owner before considering recovery.
recovery.failure.processAlive: A recorded process is still running. Inspect it and its descendants before considering recovery.
recovery.failure.lockChanged: The lock changed during review. Restart the review from a fresh inspection; do not reuse the old approval.
recovery.failure.processChanged: The process list changed after the final review. Nothing was released; inspect the latest state again.
recovery.failure.approvalRequired: The answer was not yes. No lock release was requested.
recovery.failure.maintenanceLocked: A maintenance lock exists. Inspect the active recovery operation; do not remove the lock manually.
recovery.failure.secrets: Review evidence appears to contain a credential. It was not saved; remove it and review again without secrets.
recovery.failure.postCheck: Unlock was attempted, but the final lock check did not confirm release. Do not retry automatically; inspect both locks and the audit receipt.
recovery.failure.remoteUnknown: The recovery result could not be confirmed. Check the active lock, maintenance lock, and audit record. Do not retry automatically.
recovery.failure.generic: Recovery stopped. Review the task, locks, and audit record before continuing.
recovery.failure.otherLeases: Other scoped leases remain. Recovery is refused while another task may still be active; no state was changed.
recovery.failure.noUnknownLease: No recoverable unknown lease or lease with a confirmed dead owner was found. A normally running lease will not be released.
recovery.failure.selectionMismatch: The task_id or lease ID did not exactly match the displayed target. Nothing was released.
recovery.failure.scopedRecordMismatch: The task, request tombstone, conversation linkage, or file state could not be verified. Nothing was released.
recovery.failure.auditUnavailable: The pre-release audit receipt could not be persisted. The lease was not released.
recovery.failure.auditUpdateFailed: The lease was released, but the post-release audit update could not be confirmed. Inspect the audit ID and registry; do not retry automatically.
recovery.failure.auditUpdateUnconfirmed: The failed-attempt audit update could not be confirmed either. Compare the audit ID with the lease and bridge state.
recovery.failure.postReleaseRecordFailed: The lease was released, but the task could not be finalized as interrupted/recovered. Compare the audit ID with the task, request, and conversation records.
recovery.noLock: No active execution lock. Nothing to recover.

recovery.checklist.title: Manual review checklist (the machine cannot confirm these):
recovery.checklist.processes: 1. Processes: confirm the recorded worker stopped; inspect descendants, including detached or unrecorded processes.
recovery.checklist.files: 2. Files: review relevant diffs, untracked and ignored files, and changes outside Git.

recovery.attestation: An affirmative answer attests that you manually reviewed all three categories. The audit separates these attestations from machine observations.
recovery.beforeUnlock: If all three manual reviews are complete, the existing recovery mechanism will record an audit receipt. The original task will not be replayed.
